metadata.title: ST status could have stopped migration of Hattee tribe | अगर 50 साल पहले ही मिल जाता जनजाति का दर्जा
metadata.description: The central government has recently decided to include 15 tribal groups in the list of Scheduled tribes. Hattee tribe is one of the tribal communities which will be part of this list. This tribe has fought for 50 years to get the status of scheduled tribe. We met people of this tribe who migrated for a better future from Giripar or Trans Giri area of Himachal Pradesh and asked them what difference ST status could have made to their life.
